messages:
ops-bot: ALERT: spike of 5xx (502/504) across hosted-eu-west gateway since ~12:07 UTC. Error rate ~18% for /v1/generate. Paging @sam (oncall) and @jamie (sre).
sam (oncall): Taking it. Setting war room channel. Starting quick triage.
jamie (sre): Looking at gateway metrics now. Connection pool errors up, backend 502s from inference runtime pools. Correlation with a burst of long context requests.
maria (eng-runtime): I see a KV cache pressure alert and multiple model-worker OOM restarts around the same time. Possibly large-context chat sessions bypassing cache.
leo (support): Several customers reporting timeouts and a few billing complaints for failed requests. Customer ACME sent repro steps and curl logs.
carla (pm): Which customers are highest impact? Any paying enterprise on Dedicated affected?
leo (support): Most reports from hosted free-tier & mid-market. One enterprise (FinApp) reported timeouts for 30m but they said Dedicated unaffected.
jamie (sre): Attach sample gateway log snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T12:08:19Z] proxy gateway: upstream 10.x.x.x returned 502, route=/v1/generate, conn_wait=150ms, backend_latency=2200ms
[2026-03-17T12:08:20Z] proxy gateway: circuit open for worker-group w-rt-12
```
maria (eng-runtime): Worker group w-rt-12 hosts the large-ctx-32b profile. I'm seeing heavy KV cache stalls and one slow GC causing backlog. Rolling restart in 1m on that group to clear stuck workers.
sam (oncall): Good. Jamie, can we spin up temporary routing to model-variant small-ctx while we restart? Prefer to avoid customer-facing errors.
jamie (sre): Yes. Initiating policy swap to route new requests >32k tokens to model-variant-xsmall, and enabling per-route 30s circuit-breaker. Command:
```
infractl route update --route /v1/generate --policy fallback:variant=xsmall --cb=30s
```
carla (pm): Notify affected customers about mitigation and expected degradation window. Leo, can you send a short note to FinApp and top-10 callers?
leo (support): On it. Draft: "We're seeing elevated 502/504s in eu-west for hosted API. We have a mitigation in place routing long-context requests to a variant; teams are restarting workers. Expect improvement in ~10-20m. Sorry for the disruption." Will post in enterprise channel.
maria (eng-runtime): Restart done on w-rt-12. Observing worker counts stable. KV cache pressure trending down.
jamie (sre): After routing change + restart, 5xx rate dropped from 18% -> 2.3% in the last 5m. Latency tail still slightly elevated (p99 ~1.6s) but healthy.
sam (oncall): Re-check logs for errors that could leave partial failures. Also confirm billing system didn't double-charge failed requests.
leo (support): Billing team confirms failed requests were not billed; billing events marked as error. I'll follow up with affected customers to confirm.
carla (pm): Action items for postmortem:
- eng-runtime: root cause analysis on KV cache pressure and guardrails for large-context (maria) (owner: maria, due: +48h)
- eng-sre: improve automated fallback routing to trigger before surge (jamie) (owner: jamie, due: +72h)
- product: update public status page docs about expected behavior during large-context surges (carla) (owner: carla, due: +5d)
- support: customer outreach summary + transcript (leo) (owner: leo, due: +24h)
Please ack owners.
maria (eng-runtime): Ack. I'll include heap/gc traces and sample requests.
jamie (sre): Ack. Adding a runbook step to pre-route by token-length distribution.
leo (support): Ack. Sending outreach now and collecting repro payloads.
sam (oncall): Closing war room in 30m barring regressions. Schedule postmortem doc and link here. Good job everyone. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: INCIDENT: status=mitigated, time_to_mitigate=12m, impacted_routes=["/v1/generate"], mitigation_actions=["route-fallback","worker-restart"]
sam (oncall): Confirmed customers seeing recovery. I'll open postmortem doc and add timeline. Closing thread once doc published.
leo (support): FinApp replied: "We're back to normal, thanks." Will add to summary.
carla (pm): Planning 1hr follow-up sync tomorrow 10:00 UTC to review postmortem draft. Invite sent.
sam (oncall): Thread resolved. Last note: schedule a load test for long-context traffic to validate new guards.
